function.description: Browse the Virtuals GENESIS calendar - the points-sale events that precede an agent-token launch, mostly on Base, newest first. Use this when the user asks what is launching soon on Virtuals, or wants the history of a sale; a token that already trades is virtuals__agents_discover instead. Returns `geneses` alongside count, total, page and pageSize, one row per event: id, genesisId, status, startsAt, endsAt, totalParticipants, totalVirtuals, and the linked `agent` (id, name, symbol, chain, status, tokenAddress, isVerified) or null when none is linked. Unlike the agent feeds this reads ONE provider page per call and reports it back as page/pageSize with no window scan, so ask for an older page explicitly. Read a suspicious far-future date as spam rather than as a scheduled launch. Read-only.
function.name: virtuals__genesis_launches_list

limit.description: Max geneses to return (default 20, max 100). Out of range is rejected, not clamped.

pageSize.description: Rows fetched from the provider for this page (default 100, max 200).
